entries.a0d1525e41bc292a: The group consists of the company (Kikkoman Corporation), 54 subsidiaries, and 2 affiliated companies, and the company, as a holding company, mainly formulates group strategy and oversees and manages the operating companies. The reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are 4 segments combining region and type of business: in Japan, divided into the manufacture and sale of food products and other businesses, and overseas, divided into the manufacture and sale of food products and the wholesale of Oriental food products. That is, there are 2 routes by which money comes in: 1 is manufacture and sales, selling soy sauce, food products, beverages, and alcoholic beverages that the company makes itself, and the other 1 is wholesale, purchasing Oriental food products and other products from other makers and delivering them. Of revenue from external customers of ¥745,539 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the overseas food wholesale business accounts for ¥432,800 million, more than half, so wholesale is larger in revenue, while business profit is largest in the overseas food manufacture and sales business at ¥40,929 million. Its management philosophy consists of the 3 principles of taking 'consumer-centeredness' as its basic philosophy, promoting the international exchange of food culture, and aiming to be a company whose existence is meaningful to global society, and it defines its business domain as 'the manufacture and sale of food products' and 'globally developing the provision of products and services relating to food and health.' There is no customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
